title: Signed within-visit systolic change adds no demonstrated cross-cycle albuminuria prediction beyond BP means and variability
abstract: A fixed model fitted in 5,240 NHANES 2009–2010 adults and tested in 4,915 adults from the separately sampled 2015–2016 release found negligible incremental albuminuria prediction from third-minus-first systolic BP beyond means, within-visit SD and selected clinical covariates. External AUC changed from 0.742571 to 0.742599 and log loss from 0.327964 to 0.327940; paired intervals included zero. Weighting, stronger averaging baselines and refitting uncertainty did not establish improvement. This is same-program temporal transfer, not validation in an independent measurement platform; person overlap cannot be verified from anonymous survey IDs. No clinical utility or physiological mechanism is established. Raw hash checks, scalar checks and a clean container rerun are supplied.
